import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧
  patterns.size > 0 ∧
  patterns.size < 1000000 ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < patterns.size → 
    let p := patterns.getD i #[]
    p.size < 1000000)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def patternAt (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (pid : Nat) : Array UInt8 :=
  patterns.getD pid #[]

def matchesAtBool (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all
      (fun i => haystack.getD (start + i) 0 == needle.getD i 0)

def idxMatchesAux (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (pid : Nat) :
    Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 =>
      if matchesAtBool haystack needle n then
        (pid, n) :: idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n
      else
        idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n

def allMatchesPidAux (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 =>
      allMatchesPidAux haystack patterns n ++
        idxMatchesAux haystack (patternAt patterns n) n (haystack.size + 1)

def allMatchesList (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    List (Nat × Nat) :=
  allMatchesPidAux haystack patterns patterns.size

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def ac_automata_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :
    Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (allMatchesList haystack patterns).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < needle.size → haystack.getD (start + i) 0 = needle.getD i 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (result : Array (Nat × Nat)) (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result.size →
      let pair := result.getD i (0, 0)
      let pid := pair.fst
      let idx := pair.snd
      pid < patterns.size ∧
      -- Removed duplicate `pid < patterns.size` check
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx) ∧
  (∀ pid idx : Nat,
      pid < patterns.size →
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx →
      ∃ k : Nat, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k (0, 0) = (pid, idx))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma matchesAtBool_iff_matches_at
    (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) :
    matchesAtBool haystack needle start = true ↔
      matches_at haystack needle start := by
  simp [matchesAtBool, matches_at, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range]

lemma matches_at_start_lt_succ
    {haystack : Array UInt8} {needle : Array UInt8} {start : Nat}
    (hm : matches_at haystack needle start) :
    start < haystack.size + 1 := by
  unfold matches_at at hm
  omega

lemma mem_idxMatchesAux_iff
    (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (pid n pid' idx : Nat) :
    (pid', idx) ∈ idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n ↔
      pid' = pid ∧ idx < n ∧ matches_at haystack needle idx := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [idxMatchesAux]
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hm : matches_at haystack needle n
      · have hb : matchesAtBool haystack needle n = true :=
          (matchesAtBool_iff_matches_at haystack needle n).mpr hm
        constructor
        · intro h
          simp [idxMatchesAux, hb] at h
          rcases h with heq | hrest
          · rcases heq with ⟨hp, hi⟩
            exact ⟨hp, by omega, by simpa [hi] using hm⟩
          · rcases ih.mp hrest with ⟨hpid, hlt, hmatch⟩
            exact ⟨hpid, Nat.lt_trans hlt (Nat.lt_succ_self n), hmatch⟩
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨hpid, hlt, hmatch⟩
          by_cases hidx : idx = n
          · simp [idxMatchesAux, hb, hpid, hidx]
          · have hlt' : idx < n := by omega
            have hrest : (pid', idx) ∈ idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n :=
              ih.mpr ⟨hpid, hlt', hmatch⟩
            simp [idxMatchesAux, hb, hrest]
      · have hb : matchesAtBool haystack needle n = false := by
          cases hbool : matchesAtBool haystack needle n with
          | false => rfl
          | true =>
              exact False.elim (hm ((matchesAtBool_iff_matches_at haystack needle n).mp hbool))
        constructor
        · intro h
          have hrest : (pid', idx) ∈ idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n := by
            simpa [idxMatchesAux, hb] using h
          rcases ih.mp hrest with ⟨hpid, hlt, hmatch⟩
          exact ⟨hpid, Nat.lt_trans hlt (Nat.lt_succ_self n), hmatch⟩
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨hpid, hlt, hmatch⟩
          have hlt' : idx < n := by
            by_contra hnot
            have heq : idx = n := by omega
            exact hm (by simpa [heq] using hmatch)
          have hrest : (pid', idx) ∈ idxMatchesAux haystack needle pid n :=
            ih.mpr ⟨hpid, hlt', hmatch⟩
          simpa [idxMatchesAux, hb] using hrest

    (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (n pid idx : Nat) :
    (pid, idx) ∈ allMatchesPidAux haystack patterns n ↔
      pid < n ∧ matches_at haystack (patternAt patterns pid) idx := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [allMatchesPidAux]
  | succ n ih =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp [allMatchesPidAux] at h
        rcases h with hprev | hcur
        · rcases ih.mp hprev with ⟨hpid, hmatch⟩
          exact ⟨Nat.lt_trans hpid (Nat.lt_succ_self n), hmatch⟩
        · rcases

              (haystack.size + 1) pid idx).mp hcur with
            ⟨hpid, _hidx, hmatch⟩
          subst pid
          exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self n, hmatch⟩

        by_cases hlt : pid < n
        · have hprev : (pid, idx) ∈ allMatchesPidAux haystack patterns n :=
            ih.mpr ⟨hlt, hmatch⟩
          simp [allMatchesPidAux, hprev]
        · have hpid_eq : pid = n := by omega
          subst pid
          have hidx : idx < haystack.size + 1 :=
            matches_at_start_lt_succ hmatch
          have hcur :

            (mem_idxMatchesAux_iff haystack (patternAt patterns n) n
              (haystack.size + 1) n idx).mpr ⟨rfl, hidx, hmatch⟩
          simp [allMatchesPidAux]
          exact Or.inr hcur

    (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))

      pid < patterns.size ∧
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx := by
  unfold allMatchesList
  simpa [patternAt] using
    (mem_allMatchesPidAux_iff_patternAt haystack patterns patterns.size pid idx)

    (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.getD i d ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp [List.getD]
      | succ i =>
          have hi' : i < t.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi
          have hmem : t.getD i d ∈ t := ih i hi'
          simp [List.getD]
          right
          exact hmem

    (hx : x ∈ l) :
    ∃ i : Nat, i < l.length ∧ l.getD i d = x := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
      simp at hx
      rcases hx with hxa | hxt
      · cases hxa
        exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp [List.getD]⟩
      · rcases ih hxt with ⟨i, hi, hget⟩
        exact ⟨i.succ, Nat.succ_lt_succ hi, by simpa [List.getD] using hget⟩

    (hi : i < l.toArray.size) :
    l.toArray.getD i d ∈ l := by
  have hi' : i < l.length := by
    simpa using hi
  simpa using list_getD_mem_of_lt l i d hi'

lemma array_mem_toArray_exists_getD {α : Type} {l : List α} {x d : α}
    (hx : x ∈ l) :
    ∃ k : Nat, k < l.toArray.size ∧ l.toArray.getD k d = x := by
  rcases list_mem_exists_getD_eq (l := l) (x := x) (d := d) hx with
    ⟨k, hk, hget⟩
  exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk, by simpa using hget⟩

    (h_precond : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :

      (ac_automata_search haystack patterns h_precond) h_precond := by

  constructor
  · intro i hi
    let pair := (allMatchesList haystack patterns).toArray.getD i (0, 0)
    have hmem : pair ∈ allMatchesList haystack patterns := by

  -- !benchmark @end proof
